name: shift-scheduler
description: 員工自助排班系統 — Vue 3 + Firebase (Serverless)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-shift-scheduler --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit=./.emulator-data
scripts.seed:demo: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/seed-demo.cjs
scripts.seed:prod-demo: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/seed-prod-demo.cjs
